title: New study finds health benefits of organic food | The Organic Center
summary: Organic-industry research centre's summary of the 2014 Baranski meta-analysis: organic crops have more antioxidants, less cadmium and fewer pesticide residues, presented as strong support for health benefits.

assertions.quote: organic crops had significantly higher antioxidants than conventional crops
Organic crops also had on average 48% lower cadmium levels than conventional crops.
Pesticide residues were four times more common on conventional than organic crops.
The findings of this study strongly support the health benefits of organic food.
